'''Garla Seyn''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She made frequent stops to the Republic's [[Aurek Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where she often talked with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Dav Pold]]. She often shared her knowledge with other smugglers.<ref name="TOR" />
